ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

fsm_states_picc.name: POWER_OFF
fsm_states_picc.description: Card outside operating field; no internal state.

fsm_states_picc.name: IDLE
fsm_states_picc.description: Card powered but not yet polled.

fsm_states_picc.name: READY*
fsm_states_picc.description: Same as READY but reached from HALT.

fsm_states_picc.name: ACTIVE*
fsm_states_picc.description: Same as ACTIVE but via HALT→WUPA.

fsm_states_picc.name: HALT
fsm_states_picc.description: Card executed HLTA; only WUPA wakes it.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_FIELD_ON
fsm_states_pcd.description: Carrier on; 5 ms guard for PICC POR.

fsm_states_pcd.name: PCD_HALT_AND_RESCAN
fsm_states_pcd.description: HLTA issued; rescan for more PICCs.

fsm_hints.trigger: PCD always initiates; PICC never autonomously transmits.
fsm_hints.rule: After HALT, the PCD must use WUPA (not REQA) to re-engage the same PICC.
fsm_hints.abort: PCD may always remove the field to forcibly reset all PICCs.

anti_deadlock_rule: Layer 4 (T=CL) uses 1-bit alternating block numbers per direction. After any timeout > FWT or any R(NAK), the PCD retransmits with the same block number; the PICC must respond. If the PICC requests more time it transmits S(WTX) with a multiplier ≤ 59.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On internal POR, PICC loads its OTP'd UID / ATQA / SAK templates, sets state = IDLE, sets T=CL counters to 0, and starts listening.

default_ready_state_recommendation.carrier_idle: PCD carrier present but no modulation.
default_ready_state_recommendation.antenna_loading: PCD antenna sees only the linear PICC rectifier load.

configurations.name: Type A + Type B
configurations.description: PCD alternates REQA and REQB polls.

configurations.name: Layer-3-only PICC
configurations.description: SAK bit 6 = 0; PCD never issues RATS.

configurations.name: Layer-4 (T=CL) PICC
configurations.description: SAK bit 6 = 1; PCD issues RATS → ATS.

configurations.name: Random ID (RID) mode
configurations.description: PICC reports UID0 = 0x08, UID1..UID3 randomised per POR.

timing_dependency_rule: All PCD-PICC timing is referenced to the 13.56 MHz carrier (fc). ETU at 106 kbps is 128/fc ≈ 9.44 μs. The PICC must answer REQA within fdt_listen ≤ 1172/fc ≈ 86.43 μs from the end of the PCD command; the PCD must wait fdt_poll ≥ 1172/fc before resuming polling. T=CL uses FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI.
